verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a public Invoicing API for automating invoice collection and reconciliation. Concrete REST endpoints are documented (e.g. POST /v1/invoices/create_preview), along with official client libraries and a full integration quickstart. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found none at the standard paths).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
